scenes.context: Sinai 2026-08-30: the comic marriage duet. Noa's answer on the 2026-08-16 questionnaire read 'אוי סאני פיינע' (p.113) as the speaker naming himself, and so ticked 'mint a new role' for both pronouns. It is a vocative: he is addressing her. סאניע is already in the castList as `snie` ('סאניע איין דיענסמעדכען'), and the play's recurring couple is Sanye + Yekel — pp. 19, 41-42, 84, 94-96 have them as a bickering pair, and on pp. 100-101 they are just married and exit together ('ביידע אב') immediately before this duet. So: ער = iekil, זיא = snie. Neither was offered as a candidate on the questionnaire, which is why neither could be ticked. ('ביידע' needs no override: it is already a standing collective, COLLECTIVE_XMLID -> beyde.)
